label: Fresco
description: Calm, monumental figures in soft matte color, in the manner of early Renaissance fresco painting.
rendering: A finished early Renaissance fresco-style painting of the work's world: calm, monumental figures, clear gestures and simple architecture, painted in soft matte color.
palette: Soft earth reds, ochres, sage greens and pale lapis blue on light grounds.
lighting: Even, gentle daylight with soft modelling and few cast shadows.
materials: Matte, chalky paint surface within the depicted world.
composition: Balanced, legible staging with figures in a shallow space; the scene painted out to every edge and corner.
negatives: Show the scene itself, never a wall, plaster cracks, painted border, frame or ornamental band. No letters or inscriptions anywhere, and halos, if any, are plain. Avoid photorealism and cartoon caricature.
